Untested project tools: 12 scripts and 5 lint

A screen requirement that no running test

Broken logic, data contracts or components,

Plants 1,714 small bugs in the code; every

Shipped packages with a published security
advisory, 4 reviewed ones excepted, or a
110 tests on Chromium and WebKit, Safari's engine, 360 to 1440 px wide with
phones emulated, in English and Vietnamese: layout, keyboard, accessibility and 12
page states. The release build must hold no mock data.
Builds the real iOS app and runs 2 flows on the iPhone 18 Pro simulator, iOS 27.0:
launch, phone layout, drawer, switch to Vietnamese.
Also run by hand on 9 Oct: Android 15 phone, Android 7.0 and an Android tablet;
Receives the build and a review package that opens with what is still missing
or untested, 52 screenshots and a check of 190 spec lines against the code.
Testers then work on real devices.
Planted defects the gates must catch: 37 of 37 caught
37 deliberate faults across 11 gates, such as a hand-typed size, a
skipped test or a 30 x 30 px button. A gate that stays green with
one planted is blind. Last run: 501 s.
All 13 in order on the developer's Mac: about 139 minutes, 98% of it

pnpm verify runs them in this order and reports every red one. Last full run, 10 Oct 2026: 13 of 13 green on one code tree, 52bc6629bff0.
